limitations: repository test examples, not a new user inbox or new bank
fixture-only constructed controls never used for training
no calibrated abstention: fixed top-1, threshold 0.0

desktop measurement, full JVM parser vs PyTorch classifier; hybrid is estimated sum
classification only; extraction and direction are not independently modeled
